dependencies.capability: Primary U.S. equity quotes, snapshots, liquidity, earnings/peers and broad-discovery acquisition through Finnhub and Alpaca
dependencies.blocker: Primary live capability is degraded when required credentials are absent, provider health is poor, rate limits apply, or an endpoint is plan-limited.
dependencies.userAction: Configure Finnhub and both Alpaca credentials only when primary live capability is required; verify operational endpoint entitlement and preserve approved fallbacks.

dependencies.capability: Rates, credit, inflation, labor, wages, PPI and energy context through FRED, BLS and EIA
dependencies.blocker: Direct FRED/EIA capability depends on configured credentials and upstream health; BLS baseline can operate without a credential but remains subject to upstream availability.
dependencies.userAction: Configure FRED/EIA only when their direct capabilities are required; investigate BLS only when runtime health reports the official source unavailable.

dependencies.capability: VIX, indices, FX/global context and historical recovery through Twelve Data, yfinance and CBOE
dependencies.blocker: Twelve Data requires a credential and can be plan-limited; public recovery/official fallback evidence can be unavailable, stale or delayed and must remain truthfully labeled.
dependencies.userAction: Configure Twelve Data only for enabled direct capabilities; preserve yfinance as recovery-only and CBOE as VIX validation/fallback rather than primary stock data.

dependencies.blocker: The supplemental news capability is unavailable when its credential is absent; it is not required for deterministic scoring.
dependencies.userAction: Configure Marketaux only when supplemental news fallback is desired.

dependencies.capability: Optional research generation through Groq, OpenRouter or Gemini
dependencies.blocker: The selected AI model provider is unavailable without its corresponding credential; model API entitlement does not grant rights to send provider-derived source evidence.
dependencies.userAction: Configure only the selected AI-provider credential and keep source-data AI-use permission as a separate fail-closed decision.

dependencies.blocker: Desktop persistence is blocked if the local SQLite backend cannot initialize or pass integrity/write checks.
dependencies.userAction: No normal setup action; investigate local filesystem and persistence diagnostics only if health checks fail.

dependencies.blocker: Hosted PostgreSQL requires a postgres-tagged binary and DEPULSE_DATABASE_URL; without the build tag the backend fails closed as unavailable.
dependencies.userAction: For hosted deployment, build with -tags postgres, set DEPULSE_PERSISTENCE_BACKEND=postgres and provide DEPULSE_DATABASE_URL through the deployment secret store.

dependencies.capability: Compile, test and package the Go backend
dependencies.blocker: Qualification is invalid outside an approved Go minor line or when workflow pins and release policy drift.
dependencies.userAction: No normal user action; release engineering updates the approved runtime policy and workflows together.

dependencies.capability: Node renderer contracts and Chromium browser-behavior proof
dependencies.blocker: Renderer/browser qualification cannot complete without the policy-required JavaScript runtime and Chromium-compatible browser.
dependencies.userAction: No normal user action; qualification runners provision the pinned Node runtime and browser prerequisite.

dependencies.blocker: Governance and certification evidence cannot be generated without the required Python runtime.
dependencies.userAction: No normal user action; CI provisions the pinned Python runtime.

dependencies.blocker: Release assurance is incomplete when the required security command is unavailable or not executed.
dependencies.userAction: No normal user action; release engineering provisions govulncheck for release certification.

dependencies.capability: Enable direct primary live U.S. equity evidence
dependencies.blocker: Live primary routes are degraded when required provider credentials are absent; credentials must never be committed to source.
dependencies.userAction: Store Finnhub and Alpaca credentials through Settings/secret storage when live primary equity data is enabled.

dependencies.capability: Enable the selected optional AI research provider
dependencies.blocker: The selected AI provider cannot run without its corresponding credential; source-data AI-use rights remain independent.
dependencies.userAction: Store only the credential for the selected AI provider through Settings/secret storage; do not commit credentials.

dependencies.capability: Hosted runtime origin, proxy and PostgreSQL deployment configuration
dependencies.blocker: Hosted deployment is not production-ready until runtime mode, public origin/proxy trust and PostgreSQL configuration match the deployment topology.
dependencies.userAction: Set DEPULSE_RUNTIME_MODE=hosted and explicitly configure listen/origin/proxy and PostgreSQL environment values for the target deployment; keep secrets in the deployment secret store.
